## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 resolves the three cross-domain compute carry-forwards the inv-1 surveys raised that survive dedup against inv-2…inv-12 (seed §"What genuinely survives"): (W1-1) the GGE cosmological-**collider** squeezed-limit bispectrum — does the post-transit GGE quasiparticle spectrum imprint a *non-analytic* squeezed-limit feature at a D_K eigenvalue ratio, the "spectroscopy" reading of the three SU(3)-branch Lagrange multipliers as the heavy-field content (gen UB-2, the survey's named "highest-leverage untraveled bridge"; COMPLEMENTARY to inv-10's TRANSIT-PS τ_NL — distinct object, distinct machinery); (W1-2) the a₄-induced higher-curvature (R²/Weyl²/Gauss-Bonnet) correction to the BH QNM ringdown frequency and the NS tidal Love number, from the a₄/a₂ = 1000:1 hierarchy at the fold, sign + M_KK-scale, zero new free parameters, [SIGN] on the correction direction (gen UB-3; DISTINCT from inv-11 W5-2's interior construction — this is the EXTERIOR-ringdown correction); (W1-3) the DR3-readiness truncation test — push the branch-(iv) spectral-triple-direct w₀(L) evaluator to L_max ∈ {15,16} and re-test whether the CAC cross-L_max spread converges below the 0.025 PASS band (currently 0.0443091 INFO at L∈{12,13,14}, S105), with the **CAC (canonical-anchored convention) binding form MANDATORY** per `regulator-convention-lockdown.md` (gen R1 + sagan C1, convergent across both seeds). All three are `gate_type: compute`, each independent (no intra-wave pins). Gate-type mix: **compute×3** — no workshop, no review in this wave (the wave-2 review and the honest 0-workshop count are documented in the seed).

## Wave 1 Decision Point Prerequisites

No intra-investigation upstream verdict gates any Wave-1 item (the 3 gates are mutually independent; seed §"Wave preview": "No forward intra-session pins"). Each gate consumes only EXISTING canonical artifacts (the S39/S38 GGE spectrum + s75 npz; the canonical a₄/a₂ + M_KK pins; the S105 branch-iv evaluator + the S106 high-L cache). All prerequisite artifacts are verified on-disk at plan-freeze (Wave 1 Input-SHA Ledger below). If at dispatch any pinned input is missing or its SHA drifts, the gate honestly closes per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (value=`upstream_<reason>`, NOT a forced PASS).

One PRDR prerequisite is recorded here because it is a SOURCE-FIRST-CANONICAL action, not a verdict gate: **INV13-W1-1 requires three GGE Lagrange multipliers (λ_B1, λ_B2, λ_B3) and the folded-template f_NL amplitude to be promoted into `canonical_constants.py` FIRST** (they exist as atlas-07 permanent-results / S83 WP values but are ABSENT from `canonical_constants.py` — verified at plan-freeze). Per `math-scripts.md §"Canonical Constants (MANDATORY)"` ("Add new constants to canonical_constants.py FIRST if they don't exist, then import") and `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(i)` (source from the substrate-first S39/atlas-07 closure, NEVER from prose), the executor runs `update_constant(...)` for each BEFORE importing. This is an in-script prerequisite of W1-1's producing script, declared in its `machinery_pin_map`; it is not a separate gate.

## Wave 1 → (terminal) Decision Point

Wave 1 is the terminal compute wave of investigation-13's gen-physicist-owned theme; it has no Wave-2 consumer (Wave 2 — dense-matter, growth-suppression, Bayesian re-anchor — is owned by sagan-empiricist and consumes NONE of these three verdicts; the 6 gates are independent per the seed). Each Wave-1 verdict routes to the investigation's results index + the `/rclab-investigate --investigation 13` close, where session-track promotion is decided:

- **INV13-W1-2 PASS** (detectable, definite-sign) → first anchor-free strong-field falsifier for the empty compact-object sector → mack falsifier-row candidate (session-track) constraining M_KK. **INFO** (definite-sign, sub-detectable) → a clean future-falsifier null (the framework predicts the sign; detectors not yet there).
